topic.title: Freeports / Tax Sites / Customs Sites / Delivery
topic.source_contract: Freeport outer boundary, designated tax and customs sites, responsible authority, customs authorisation, tax eligibility, land and premises use, planning consents, infrastructure, occupation, jobs, compliance and monitored delivery evidence

scope_guards: A Freeport outer boundary is not treated as a tax or customs site.
A designated tax site is not treated as planning permission.
A customs site authorisation is not treated as business occupation.
An announced investment is not treated as committed capital expenditure.
A tax-relief claim is not treated as completed development.
Seed funding is not treated as delivered infrastructure.
Job targets are not treated as measured employment.
No score or promotion is written without exact site designation, consent, investment, occupation and monitored delivery evidence.
